signatures_note.original_script: Актъ сей свидѣтелямъ прочитанъ нами и однимъ свидѣ-телемъ подписанъ. Второй свидѣт[ель] неграмотенъ

translation: Took place in posad Serock, 11 December 1890 at 12 noon. Appeared personally Moszek Rozenberg, trader, 36, and Berek [unclear: Kaszu/Koltun], laborer, 65, both residing in posad Serock, and declared that yesterday at 10 PM died a child of male sex named Josek [unclear: Zalcberg/Zalberg], half a year old, son of [unclear: Madech/Manes] and [unclear: La-Gita] nee Bogdan. Upon eyewitness certification of the death of Josek Zal[c]berg this act was read to the witnesses, signed by us and one witness; the second witness is illiterate.
